Stasis

In Etherlords and Etherlords II

Heroes do not gain ether by any means while Stasis is active. The controller of this enchantment must pay ether at the beginning of each turn or remove Stasis from play. The cost for maintaining Stasis in play is 2 ether on the first turn, then increases by 2 each following turn

Changes in Etherlords II

  • Description in Etherlords:

    Heroes do not gain ether at the beginning of their turn. The controller of this enchantment must pay 2 ether at the beginning of each turn or remove Stasis from play
